title: Fourier coefficients of a sparse expansion
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\\mathcal F$ be a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates, and assign a real coefficient $c_S$ to every subset $S$. The Fourier coefficient at any subset $T$ of the function $x\\mapsto\\sum_{S\\in\\mathcal F}c_S\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i$ is $c_T$ if $T\\in\\mathcal F$, and is zero otherwise.
